remarks: This bright and spacious 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath end-unit townhome in River West offers privacy, comfort, and stunning river views. The main level features an open-concept living and dining area with a cozy wood-burning fireplace, plus a large kitchen. Step out onto the private deck for peaceful outdoor space. Upstairs, a versatile loft with vaulted ceilings, fireplace and custom built-ins is perfect for a family room, home office, or primary suite. The walkout garden level includes an ensuite bedroom, additional bedroom or office, full bath, and laundry room, offering flexibility for guests or remote work. The pet-friendly complex includes a charming wooden bridge leading to "The Mill" yoga, dining, and easy access to vibrant downtown Glenville. Additional perks include an oversized garage with keyless entry, extra assigned parking space, and easy access to Metro North, I-95, and the Merritt Parkway. Just minutes from Greenwich's amazing amenities shopping, beaches, parks, and more. A commuter's dream and a perfect place to call home. Total of 2,412 sq ft of living space.
